author: packs
description: Enterprise architecture (X11-T1) on today's four entities: application portfolio fields (the ITSM application CI it describes, vendor, hosting, annual cost, business and technical fit, TIME decision with rationale and savings), technology standards, owner assessments, interfaces and data flows between applications, architecture reviews from intake to decision, and target-state roadmap items tied to projects. Roles, report queries, and sidebar routes fixed to the generic entity list.
name: enterprise-architecture-portfolio

definition.description: Owns the portfolio, standards, reviews and roadmap.
definition.name: Enterprise Architect
Architecture: TIME Portfolio
definition.sql: SELECT time_decision, COUNT(*) AS applications, SUM(annual_cost) AS annual_cost, SUM(estimated_savings) AS savings FROM ea_application WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) GROUP BY time_decision ORDER BY time_decision

definition.name: Architecture: Technology Past or Near End of Support
definition.sql: SELECT id, name, vendor, version, end_of_support FROM ea_technology WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND end_of_support < NOW() + INTERVAL '180 days' ORDER BY end_of_support

target.query: Architecture: Technology Past or Near End of Support

definition.name: Architecture: Open Reviews
definition.sql: SELECT id, title, status, created_at FROM ea_review WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND status IN ('intake', 'in_review') ORDER BY created_at

title: Pack: enterprise architecture portfolio, assessments and reviews
